_comment: Accepted-risk registry for this project. See audit-system skill references/exception-registry.md for the schema and rules. IDs use the project's PREFIX (declared in .security/audits/README.md). All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. The CI gate fails on any cited exception whose expires_at has passed.
